label: Quest

intro: This crucial step in the investigation of Stalvan Mistmantle brings the gathered evidence before Darkshire's authorities. With a bloodstained journal page in hand, Commander Althea Ebonlocke directs the investigator to Clerk Daltry to authenticate the handwriting once and for all.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime. But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.
In all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting. Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Back again, friend? What do you have this time?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Why yes! The writing on this page does in fact match that of the registry signatures.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
